newsitem.title: USA: MichCon responds to gas leaks after storm.
newsitem.headline: MichCon responds to gas leaks after storm.

text.p: Michigan Consolidated Gas Co. said Thursday that crews have responded to 177 reported gas leaks in Detroit and surrounding areas following a series of of severe storms Wednesday.
Detroit's northwest side and the nearby community of Grosse Pointe Farms reported numerous leaks, the company said, but no reports of injury of illness.
MichCon called in extra crews through the night. They initially had trouble reaching damaged areas because of heavy debris, traffic and bystanders.
MichCon is a wholly owned subsidiary of MCN Energy Group Inc.
